message.content: {"note_claim": "Pro-Saudi Yemeni government (PLC) forces retreated/surrendered in Hodeidah and Taiz provinces including Mokha and Hays, and the surrendering forces were local Yemeni allied fighters, not Saudi national military troops.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Houthis capture Hanish Islands, Hays and Al Khawkhah districts in Al-Hudaydah Governorate and Mokha and Dhubab districts in Taiz Governorate", "reason": "The page directly confirms Houthi captures of Hays and Mokha in the named provinces, and the combatant/unit listings show the opposing forces are Yemeni PLC units and allied fighters, not Saudi national military troops."}

parsed.note_claim: Pro-Saudi Yemeni government (PLC) forces retreated/surrendered in Hodeidah and Taiz provinces including Mokha and Hays, and the surrendering forces were local Yemeni allied fighters, not Saudi national military troops.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Houthis capture Hanish Islands, Hays and Al Khawkhah districts in Al-Hudaydah Governorate and Mokha and Dhubab districts in Taiz Governorate
parsed.reason: The page directly confirms Houthi captures of Hays and Mokha in the named provinces, and the combatant/unit listings show the opposing forces are Yemeni PLC units and allied fighters, not Saudi national military troops.
